newsitem.title: USA: Dunavant sees 96/97 US cotton crop 18.8 mln bales.
newsitem.headline: Dunavant sees 96/97 US cotton crop 18.8 mln bales.

text.p: Leading cotton merchant William B. Dunavant Jr. pegged the 1996/97 U.S. cotton crop at 18.8 million 480-lb bales or slightly higher.
The USDA put the crop at 18.74 million bales in its December supply/demand report. The January report will be issued on Thursday.
Dunavant said domestic consumption will reach 10.9 million bales and exports will be 6.4 million bales.
"Currently U.S. export registrations are nearly 4.5 million bales, so we have to register approximately 2.3 million to 2.5 million more bales to reach 6.4 million bales," Dunavant said.
He put imports at 400,000 bales and final carryover between 4.5 million to 4.6 million bales. Carryover totaled 2.61 million bales last season.
